<input type='hidden' name='_csrf' value='...'> inside every POST form and every HTMX hx-post/put/patch/delete form. Never inside a GET form (method="get", no method, hx-get), so a search or filter form's URL never carries the token.

<script type="importmap"> mapping bm → /_internal/bm.js and sdui → /_internal/sdui.js, each with a ?v= content hash: a map the page authors (the scaffold ships one) gets the ?v= on its bm URL and the sdui entry; a page with a <script type="module"> and no import map gets the whole map injected before its first module script; a page with no module script gets none
Cache-Control: no-store on HTML (the token rotates)
